'''Droom's Gambit''' was a tactic in the game [[Firepath/Legends|Firepath]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the strategy was used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]&mdash;disguised as the [[Surgeon's Variant]] strategy&mdash; to defeat [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Dhol]] during his [[Mission to Cheelit|mission]] to [[Cheelit/Legends|Cheelit]].
